# J118 floating checkpoint recovery capsule part 1/3

Complete literal binary64 normal arrays, without rounding. CP_ files are new compact wrappers, not byte aliases of original receipt files. Source hashes identify provenance. This part supplies the completed one-step CLASS118 timeout prefix and the subsequent CLASS118_SMALL endpoint; part2 supplies finite-cut inputs, part3 the Q-only fragmentation controls. Each pair is independently reconstructible. Full producing code, commands, versions and execution limits are in [internal-source-reference] and [internal-source-reference]. Exact C408 recovery is separate in [internal-source-reference] plus exact115.cpp; these floating inputs are not equilibrium certificates.

Save the JSON block with final newline as CP118_PART1.json, 8920 bytes/SHA256 0c3150c9e3f50bc60c82b0ebe694b9242ca9c9148b9305412921d5c907cac22e. Reconstruct and check with this complete Python code:
```python
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
b=Path('CP118_PART1.json').read_bytes()
assert len(b)==8920 and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='0c3150c9e3f50bc60c82b0ebe694b9242ca9c9148b9305412921d5c907cac22e'
for name,r in json.loads(b).items():
    z=(json.dumps({'normals':r['normals']},separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
    assert len(z)==r['checkpoint_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(z).hexdigest()==r['checkpoint_sha256']
    Path(name).write_bytes(z)
print('J118_FLOAT_CHECKPOINT_PART1_EXACT_BYTES_PASS 2')
```
CLASS118 completed initial repair and ONE saved accepted step before timeout, not four requested steps. CLASS118_SMALL accepted one step then NO_STEP. Numerical P values .3296468150980579/.3294068150980576, S1/U2,Q[],F69/E201. No own110 claim.
